title: Sorry, Sandeep Maheshwari, But Here Is My Final Reply Exposing Your Prao Scam
description:
Check out Odoo to build your website. Here is the link:
https://www.odoo.com/r/rjLL

In this video, I break down the complete reality behind Sandeep Maheshwari's 'Prao' business campaign. I recently made a video questioning this initiative, to which he replied, though I noticed he has now deleted that Prao (My new business by Saneep Maheshwari) video.

My core allegation is that the youth are being misguided for profit, masked behind patriotism and an "India First" narrative. He instructed his audience to treat his business like a dropshipping website. To see if this actually works, I tested it myself. Inside, I provide a full demonstration explaining how real dropshipping functions and why the 'Prao' model is fundamentally flawed.

I acknowledge there might be communication gaps here. Sandeep Maheshwari is a massive figure who has done incredible work far beyond my abilities, and I respect his legacy. I am not looking for an apology. What I want is accountability. I want him to clarify these mistakes, take responsibility for the business model being pushed to his audience, and stop disrespecting creators like me who are simply asking valid questions.

Watch the full practical demonstration and let me know your thoughts in the comments.
